explanation: The claim that neutropenia is 'non-cumulative' is not supported by any evidence shown; none of the sources describe cumulative vs. non-cumulative pattern. Also, CBC monitoring omits Day 1 of each cycle per label evidence.
suggested_rewrite: Remove 'non-cumulative' claim unless separate evidence confirms it; update monitoring to 'CBC before starting, Days 1 and 15 of cycles 1-2, Day 1 of subsequent cycles.'
